mapper.select: SELECT rai.prod_id prodId, SUM(IFNULL(rai.TDY_COST_AMT,0)) assetsValueNet FROM REP_ASSET_INDEX rai WHERE 1=1 AND rai.VALUE_DATE=STR_TO_DATE(#{executeDateStr},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY rai.prod_id

SELECT rai.prod_id prodId, sum(rai.TDY_COST_AMT) assetsValueNet, info.ASSET_TYPE_DIS assetTypeCode, rai.VALUE_DATE valDate FROM rep_asset_index rai LEFT JOIN rep_asset_info info ON rai.busi_id = info.asset_id AND info.status ='E' WHERE rai.VALUE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{executeDateStr},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY rai.prod_id, info.ASSET_TYPE_DIS, rai.VALUE_DATE

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT PROD_ID prodId, RATE rate FROM REP_PROD_INVEST_ADJRATE WHERE 1=1 AND PROD_ID =#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INVEST_TYPE =#{assetTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STR_TO_DATE(#{executeDateStr},'%Y-%m-%d') >= INVEST_ADJUST_DATE ORDER BY INVEST_ADJUST_DATE DESC ) t LIMIT 1
